start.title: Very Wealthy
start.text:
You come back from Egypt to the Negev, and then to the hills between Bethel and Ai.
How wealthy are you now?

choices.text: Very wealthy â in livestock, silver and gold
Poor and empty-handed from the journey
The same as before, with no change

tension.title: The Land Cannot Support You
tension.text:
Both you and your nephew Lot have flocks, herds and tents.
What is the trouble?

choices.text: The land cannot support you both together, for your possessions are too great
You have too little livestock to feed anyone
A great enemy is attacking both camps
Quarreling breaks out between your herdsmen and Lot's herdsmen
Peace and joy spread through both camps
Lot's herdsmen leave without a word

decision.title: You Speak to Lot
decision.text:
You want to end the strife.
What do you say to Lot?

choices.text: 'Let's not have any quarreling between you and me â we are close relatives'
'You must leave at once â you are not my equal'
Say nothing and drive Lot out

offering.title: First Choice
offering.text:
You offer Lot a choice.
What do you say?

choices.text: 'If you go to the left, I'll go to the right; if you go to the right, I'll go to the left'
'I am the elder â I will choose first'
'We will both stay here and share every well'

lots_choice.title: Lot Looks Up
lots_choice.text:
Lot looks around at the land.
What does he choose?

choices.text: Lot chooses the whole plain of the Jordan, well watered like the garden of the Lord
Lot chooses the dry hill country
Lot refuses to choose and stays with Abram

lot_departs.title: The Parting
lot_departs.text:
You and Lot part ways.
Where does Lot go?

choices.text: Lot sets out toward the east and pitches his tents near Sodom
Lot travels far west across the sea
Lot goes back to Haran

remaining.title: Where You Live
remaining.text:
Lot is gone.
Where do you live?

choices.text: Live in the land of Canaan
Live in the plain of the Jordan near Sodom
Live in Egypt

the_promise.title: Lift Up Your Eyes
the_promise.text:
The Lord speaks to you after Lot has parted from you.
What does He say?

choices.text: 'Lift up your eyes; all the land you see I will give to you and your offspring forever'
'You will lose this land to Lot's descendants'
'Return to Haran; the land is not yours'

mamre.title: Walk Through the Land
mamre.text:
The Lord tells you what to do next.
What is it?

choices.text: 'Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you'
'Stay in one place and never travel again'
'Give the land back to the Canaanites'

altar.title: The Great Trees of Mamre
altar.text:
So you move your tents and go to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron,
where you build an altar to the Lord.
